simple.meaning: אֲרֻחָה (ʼăruchâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a ration of food.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֲרֻחָה (H737) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Kings 25:30, with occurrences in 2 Kings, Proverbs, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲרֻחָה (H737) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֲרֻחָה (H737) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֲרֻחָה (ʼăruchâh) / H737 is traced through 2 Kings 25:30, Proverbs 15:17, Jeremiah 40:5, Jeremiah 52:34 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H737. aruchah אֲרֻחָה noun feminine meal, allowance (of food) absolute Jer 40:5 ; construct יָרָק אֲרֻחַת Prov 15:17 a portion of herbs , i.e. a slender meal; elsewhere of allowance given to captive king Jehoiachin, ׳א תָּמִיד a continual allowance 2Kin 25:30 = Jer 52:34 ; אֲרֻחָתוֺ ib. = id.
definitions.rootNote: feminine passive participle of 732 (in the sense of appointing);
